Ben Stokes expresses desire to coach England after cricket retirement

England cricketer Ben Stokes has stated his ambition to coach the England team after retiring from international cricket. He also commented on Harry Brook, calling him a "freakishly talented" player who unexpectedly struggled as a Test captain. Stokes has ruled out returning to play in the Ashes series. He indicated he is preparing for a future coaching role within the sport.
